name: Slack Notify on Complete
description: Sends a Slack notification via webhook when Claude completes a session
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Send Slack notification when session completes
SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL="${SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL:-}"
if [ -z "$SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL" ]; then
  echo "SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL not set, skipping notification"
  exit 0
fi
PROJECT=$(basename "$(pwd)")
MESSAGE="Claude Code session completed in *${PROJECT}*"
curl -s -X POST "$SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d "{\"text\": \"$MESSAGE\"}" >/dev/null 2>&1
exit 0
